protocol:
# Worker Readiness Protocol (replicated coordination between the coordinator on g1-server and one agent per worker)

This folder is in the shared worktree: what a worker writes here reaches the coordinator within seconds and the other way round. Re-read this file at the start of every round; the coordinator changes it.

`W` = this folder. `<origin>` = the `originId` in `<worktree>/.cache/f/machine.json` (e.g. `g1-m03`). Worktree: macOS `~/Documents/semio`, Linux `~/semio`, Windows `C:\semio`.

## Rules for the worker agent
- Change no file outside `W/workers/<origin>/`. No build code, no fixes: the coordinator's agents fix in one place; you observe and report. (Several workers fixing the same files last night cost hours.)
- No git command that changes anything, no pkill/killall, no sudo, never print tokens. Kill only processes you started.
- One graph command at a time on the machine (`repo run`, `repo show`, `repo cargo`, the bootstrap): they queue behind each other.
- Write numbers as measured; say "not measured" otherwise.

## Round
1. Read `W/workers/<origin>/next.md` if it exists (instructions for this machine only), else `W/ROUND.md` (instructions for all). Each has a line `round: <n>`. If you already reported round n (`W/workers/<origin>/round-<n>.md` exists), wait: check every 60 seconds for a higher round, at most 6 hours, then stop.
2. Do what the round says. Unless it says otherwise the round is: run `W/native-bootstrap.sh "$HOME/native-bootstrap-round-<n>.log"` once, in the foreground.
3. Report in `W/workers/<origin>/round-<n>.md`: machine (memory, free disk, OS), code digest of the replica daemon (`status`), start and end time, `native_rc`, every failed task with its first error line verbatim and the 15 lines before it, the `[capacity]` and `graph:` lines verbatim, peak resident size seen (sample `ps -axo rss,command | sort -nr | head -3` every 30 s), wall time per phase. Copy the last 200 lines of the log to `W/workers/<origin>/round-<n>.tail.txt`.
4. Write `W/workers/<origin>/state.json`: `{"origin":"<origin>","round":<n>,"native_rc":<code>,"ready":<true|false>,"failed":["<task>",…],"at":"<UTC time>"}`. `ready` is true only when `native_rc` is 0 and `<worktree>/.cache/f/native-bootstrap.done` exists.
5. When ready: run `repo preflight --lang en` and the replica `status`, add both to the report, and stop. Otherwise go to 1.
instructions:
round: 9

For g1-m08: follow `ROUND.md` round 9 like every other machine.
global_round:
round: 9

Every machine. If an earlier round is still running: one SIGINT, write its report, then start.

ROUND 9 = ROUND 8 WITHOUT THE WAIT FOR A CLICK (posted 22:15 UTC; logs `…-round-9…`). Stop waiting for the consent and run the next try now. Landed at about 22:10 UTC (replica digest `590fdef8b758…`): when `repo` (the launcher) has no consent yet but the process that starts the command can read the worktree itself, the graph service is started as a direct child under the caller's access and the command goes on (one line says so: record it as "runs under the app's access", it is not a failure). `native_rc=4` now appears only when neither the launcher nor your own process can read the worktree: then report it and stop, as before. Everything else as in round 8 (steps 1, 2, 4, 5, 6; the launcher's inode and CDHash must stay unchanged from run to run). New since round 8 as well: a project too heavy for this machine is asked from the fleet and named in the refusal text (`native_rc=75`): report the names.

What changed since round 7 (all landed, none seen on a worker yet):
- macOS: the consent was lost because EVERY bootstrap run replaced the launcher file (g1-m03 measured it: rebuilt at 20:35:26Z, the running graph service denied four minutes later). The installer now leaves an unchanged launcher alone, installs real changes as `versions/<hash>/repo` behind an atomic link, and signs it with the identifier `tech.semio.repo`. The FIRST bootstrap of this round installs that new signed launcher once, so macOS asks ONE more time; after the owner's click it holds across bootstrap runs.
- The graph service job is started on demand (no more `runs = 0`), carries no caller environment, and a pending consent ends within seconds with `native_rc=4` and the text of what to click.
- The replica agent no longer exits towards launchd on code changes (`bootVersion` 6).
- All seven task failures of g1-m03's run have a fix in the tree (`cpp-setup`, `deps-build-tools`, `plugin-registry:generate`, `framework-os-mcp-rs:build`, and `deps-cargo`/`deps-trunk`/`deps-tools` under a peer's edit); a project record replaced while it is read and a missing `build-input-closures` file now count as a miss.

Do this:
1. If your replica agent is down (`launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/tech.semio.fleet.replica` → `state = not running`; Linux: the systemd user unit), start it (`launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/tech.semio.fleet.replica`) and wait until `.cache/f/health.json` is fresh; report how often. Report the replica code digest and `bootVersion`.
2. Try 1: run `W/native-bootstrap.sh "$HOME/native-bootstrap-round-8.log"`. On macOS record BEFORE and AFTER it: `ls -li ~/.local/share/semio/launcher/bin/repo ~/.local/bin/repo`, `readlink` of the launcher path if it is a link, and `codesign -dvvv <launcher> 2>&1 | grep -E "Identifier|CDHash"`.
3. If a try ends with `native_rc=4` (consent): write `"consent"` and the printed text into the report and into `state.json` (`"native_rc":4`), then WAIT for the owner's click instead of ending the round: every 60 s run `repo preflight --lang en` (read-only) and look at the `access` line; when it says ok, or after 30 minutes at the latest, run the next try. The owner is told to click "Allow" for `repo` (identifier `tech.semio.repo`, path `~/.local/share/semio/launcher/bin/repo`) on your Mac.
4. Try again (at most 10 tries, `…-round-8-try-<k>.log`): after the consent wait; after `native_rc=75` or a fleet refusal (wait 2 minutes); after a hard stop (wait 3 minutes); after a try whose task failures include `source-differs`, `closure.moving` or "retry" wording (wait 2 minutes). Stop when two tries in a row fail with the same task errors of another kind.
5. From the SECOND bootstrap run on, the launcher must be untouched: report inode, mtime and CDHash again after each try and say plainly whether they changed.
6. Hard stops as in round 6. Report per try as in round 6 (graph lines; succeeded / failed / not-run tasks with the first error line and 15 lines before it for each failed task). If `native_rc=0` and the marker exists: `ready: true`, then `repo preflight --lang en` and the replica `status`, and stop.
